measurement.lab-subtitle: Where SWR and power reading errors come from — try it yourself
measurement.swr-demo-hint: The meter can never read higher than the truth: line loss attenuates the reflected wave too. Drag the loss and watch the curve peel away from the diagonal.
measurement.meter-vs-true: A meter reading of {} : 1 means roughly {} : 1 at the antenna
measurement.directivity-note: Error in the other direction comes from directivity: a typical SWR meter has about 20 dB, so readings below about 1.2 : 1 are not to be trusted.
measurement.swr-chart: Meter reading vs. true antenna SWR
measurement.solt-hint: Calibration is the precondition of measurement: uncalibrated S-parameters include cable and instrument errors.
